[[sn:Sky Library]]Bathed in the ethereal glow of countless stars, the [[Sky Library]] emerges as a sanctuary of wisdom amidst the cosmic expanse. Housed within the central pillar of the O'Neill Cylinder, this celestial haven beckons adventurers to navigate the dualities of stasis and metamorphosis, reality and role-play, all under the watchful gaze of the residing Goddess.

== Background ==
In the vastness of space, the Sky Library, an ode to the infinite stories of the cosmos, serves as both a repository of knowledge and a stage where identities blur, evolve, and harmonize.

== Location ==
Perched in the heart of the O'Neill Cylinder, the library spirals through the very essence of the space habitat, an abode of the Goddess, shining a beacon of enlightenment across the galaxy.

== Aspect ==
Intertwining the thrill of Larping with the evocative Moth Aspect, the Sky Library invites participants to don myriad roles, embrace fleeting emotions, and unravel concealed truths.

== Dungeon Item ==
Armed with the groundbreaking [[Portal Gun]], adventurers gain the ability to bridge distances in the blink of an eye, conjuring portals that offer swift navigation through the zero-gravity realm.

== Key Object ==
The enigmatic ''Mirror of Empathy'' offers a window not to one's exterior but to the myriad personas and perspectives lying dormant within. Gazing upon its reflective surface, seekers experience a myriad of lives, fostering understanding and unity.

== Midboss ==
The elusive ''Persona Paradox'' emerges as a manifestation of juxtaposed identities. Not a foe in the traditional sense, it guides seekers towards internal harmony, urging them to reconcile their diverse roles.

== Boss ==
The formidable Stagnator, emblematic of resistance to evolution, wields the power to bind adventurers to past viewpoints. Yet, armed with the Portal Gun and lessons of Larping, challengers can counteract:
*** Phase 1: Evasively harnessing the Portal Gun, adventurers elude the snares of past memories set by The Stagnator.
*** Phase 2: Invoking a tapestry of tales from the Sky Library, they assail The Stagnator with fresh perspectives.
*** Phase 3: The ''Mirror of Empathy'' shines a transformative light upon The Stagnator, prompting an embrace of change.

== Dungeon Description ==
Floating amidst celestial wonders, the Sky Library provides an arena where weightlessness dictates exploration. The absence of gravity paves the way for momentum-driven puzzles and unique challenges, with the Portal Gun enabling seamless transitions between vast expanses. Larping, integral to this realm, immerses participants in ever-changing roles, setting the stage for their confrontation with The Stagnator.

== Surrounding Location ==
The [[Celestial Pillars]], a constellation of hovering islands and majestic edifices, encircle the Sky Library, each enclave echoing with its own enigmatic tales and tests.

== Guardian Spirit ==
The ethereal [[Immanuelle]], sovereign of the heavens and custodian of cosmic lore, accompanies pilgrims on their celestial odyssey, bestowing guidance and celestial blessings.

== Exploration of Theme ==
Within the confines of the Sky Library, the age-old tussle between inertia and transformation comes alive. Enhancements propelling the experience include:
*** Celestial Physics: Ingenious puzzles leverage space's weightlessness, pushing the boundaries of momentum and inertia.
*** Cosmic Chronicles: As the journey unfolds, seekers stumble upon ancient prophecies, weaving a narrative of the universe's grand tapestry.

Amidst the celestial grandeur, the Sky Library stands as a testament to the eternal quest for understanding, urging adventurers to defy the bounds of self and soar towards uncharted horizons.
